hexagrams.summary: Pure creative force. Steady, principled action brings lasting success.
hexagrams.image: Heaven keeps turning without pause; build your strength without letting up.
line_texts: A dragon still hidden. The potential is real, but it is not time to act.
The dragon shows itself in the field. Look for a mentor or a person of stature.
Busy all day, watchful at night. Risky, but you are not at fault.
Hovering over the deep. Testing your strength now is no mistake.
The dragon in flight. Influence peaks; connect with people of stature.
The dragon that overreaches. Pride at the top leads to regret.

hexagrams.summary: Yielding, devoted support. Follow rather than lead, and steady service succeeds.
hexagrams.image: The earth is broad and carries everything; carry others with generous character.
line_texts: Frost underfoot means hard ice is coming. Read early signs.
Straight, square and broad. Natural integrity succeeds without forcing it.
Keep your talents under cover. Serve the work and let others take the credit.
A sack tied shut. Discretion earns neither blame nor praise.
A plain yellow garment. Quiet, modest refinement is very fortunate.
Dragons clash in the open field. Resisting the natural order draws blood.

hexagrams.summary: New life pushing through chaos. Don't rush; persevere and gather helpers.
hexagrams.image: Cloud and thunder churn together; bring order out of confusion.
line_texts: Stalled at the outset. Hold steady and find helpers.
Problems pile up and a suitor withdraws. Wait; it resolves in time.
Chasing deer without a guide leads deep into the woods. Better to stop.
Horse and cart separated. Seek the alliance now; moving ahead is fortunate.
Hard to share your blessings. Small steps work; big moves fail.
Horse and cart separated, weeping bitterly. Change course or despair.

hexagrams.summary: Inexperience looking for guidance. A teacher answers sincere questions, not badgering.
hexagrams.image: A spring rises at the foot of a mountain; cultivate character through thorough action.
line_texts: Correct the beginner, but don't clamp on chains.
Be patient and kind with the inexperienced. Fortunate.
Don't chase what dazzles you. Nothing comes of it.
Stuck in ignorance and stubbornness. Embarrassment follows.
Childlike openness to learning. Fortunate.
Correct folly firmly, but aim to prevent harm, not to punish.

hexagrams.summary: Patience before action. Wait with confidence and sincerity, and the crossing will succeed.
hexagrams.image: Clouds gather in the sky; eat, drink and stay calm while waiting.
line_texts: Waiting out in the open. Keep your routine; no fault.
Waiting on the sand. Some gossip, but it ends well.
Waiting in the mud invites trouble to arrive.
Waiting in blood. Climb out of the pit.
Waiting with food and wine. Steady patience is fortunate.
Fallen into the pit, three unexpected visitors come. Treat them with respect and it ends well.

hexagrams.summary: Opposing claims. Settle halfway, seek a fair judge, and don't push the dispute to the bitter end.
hexagrams.image: Sky and water move apart; plan carefully at the very start of any venture.
line_texts: Don't drag the matter on. A little talk, then good fortune.
You can't win this. Withdraw home and avoid disaster.
Live on what you've earned before. Serve without chasing credit.
You can't win the case. Turn back, accept it, and find peace.
Bringing the case to a just arbiter is very fortunate.
An honor won by fighting is taken away again and again.

hexagrams.summary: Organized collective strength. It needs discipline, a just cause and an experienced leader.
hexagrams.image: Water stored within the earth; care for people and build up your reserves.
line_texts: The troops set out in good order. Without discipline, misfortune.
The leader in the midst of the troops is honored by the ruler. Fortunate.
Carrying corpses in the wagon. Divided command brings disaster.
The army falls back. A sensible retreat is no fault.
Game in the field; capture it. Let the seasoned leader command, not the novice.
The ruler hands out rewards. Give them to the capable, not to petty people.

hexagrams.summary: Union around a center. Check your sincerity; those who come late miss out.
hexagrams.image: Water on the earth; form close bonds and keep them up.
line_texts: Sincerity first. A full, honest vessel brings unexpected luck.
Unity coming from within. Staying true is fortunate.
Joining with the wrong people.
Joining openly with the leader. Steady loyalty is fortunate.
The king hunts on three sides and lets game escape the fourth. Union freely given.
A union with no head. Misfortune.

hexagrams.summary: Gentle restraint of a strong force. Clouds gather but no rain yet; small efforts add up.
hexagrams.image: Wind blows across the sky; refine how your character shows outwardly.
line_texts: Returning to your own way. No fault; fortunate.
Drawn back along with others. Fortunate.
The wheel's spokes break; partners quarrel.
With sincerity, bloodshed and fear fall away. No fault.
Loyal ties bind neighbors together and wealth is shared.
The rain has come and things settle. Restraint is complete; don't press on.

hexagrams.summary: Stepping on the tiger's tail and not getting bitten. Careful, courteous conduct succeeds.
hexagrams.image: Sky above, lake below; distinguish high from low and steady people's aims.
line_texts: Plain, simple conduct. Going forward is no fault.
A level, easy path. Quiet steadiness is fortunate.
Seeing with one eye, walking on a lame leg; the tiger bites. Reckless.
Stepping on the tiger's tail with great care ends well.
Determined steps. Keep going, but stay aware of the danger.
Look back at the path you walked. If it holds up, great good fortune.

hexagrams.summary: Heaven and earth in contact. The small leaves, the great arrives; harmony and prosperity.
hexagrams.image: Heaven and earth unite; give shape to their gifts for the people.
line_texts: Pull one reed and the roots come with it. Joint efforts succeed.
Bear with the rough, cross the river, keep to the middle way.
Every plain has a slope. Stay faithful through hardship.
Coming down to share with neighbors, without showing off wealth.
The ruler gives a daughter in marriage. Blessing and great fortune.
The wall slides back into the moat. Don't use force; accept the turn.

hexagrams.summary: Heaven and earth out of touch. Lesser forces rise; withdraw and keep your integrity.
hexagrams.image: Heaven and earth don't meet; step back and decline tempting rewards.
line_texts: Pull one reed and the roots come with it. Stay steady together.
Petty people flatter and tolerate. The great person accepts the standstill.
Carrying a sense of shame.
Acting under a higher mandate is no fault; companions share the blessing.
The standstill is ending. Stay mindful of failure and anchor yourself.
The standstill is overturned. First blockage, then gladness.

hexagrams.summary: Community in the open, built on shared purpose rather than private interest.
hexagrams.image: Fire rising toward heaven; organize groups and sort things by kind.
line_texts: Fellowship at the gate, in the open. No fault.
Fellowship only among your own clan. Embarrassing.
Weapons hidden in the brush; years pass without rising.
Climbing the wall but not attacking. Fortunate.
Weeping first, then laughter, as true allies meet after struggle.
Fellowship out in the meadow. No regret.

hexagrams.summary: Abundant success, held with modesty and clear sight.
hexagrams.image: Fire high in the sky; curb the harmful, promote the good.
line_texts: No harmful entanglements. Know the difficulty and you stay blameless.
A big wagon for the load. You have somewhere to go; no fault.
A noble offers wealth to the ruler. A petty person couldn't.
Don't try to outshine your neighbor. No fault.
Sincere and dignified, yet approachable. Fortunate.
Blessed from above. Good fortune; everything works.

hexagrams.summary: Modesty carries things through. The humble person finishes what they start.
hexagrams.image: A mountain hidden inside the earth; reduce the excessive and add to the lacking.
line_texts: Modest about being modest. You can cross great water. Fortunate.
Modesty that shows itself. Staying true is fortunate.
Modest and hard-working. You'll see it through.
Modesty in action. Everything works.
Don't flaunt wealth, but act with force when it's needed.
Modesty that speaks up; discipline your own ranks.

hexagrams.summary: Inspired readiness. Rally helpers and move people together in harmony.
hexagrams.image: Thunder bursts from the earth; music and ritual honor the past.
line_texts: Bragging about your enthusiasm. Misfortune.
Firm as a rock, not waiting a day. Steadiness is fortunate.
Gazing upward for approval brings regret; delay brings more.
The source of the enthusiasm. Great achievement; gather friends without doubt.
Chronically unwell, but it doesn't end you.
Lost in blind enthusiasm. Changing course now avoids blame.

hexagrams.summary: Adapting to the times. Follow what is right and others will follow you.
hexagrams.image: Thunder resting in the lake; when evening comes, go in and rest.
line_texts: Standards shift. Stay true and go out to meet others.
Holding to the small one, losing the strong one.
Holding to the strong one, letting the small one go.
Following that brings gain, but clinging to it goes wrong. Stay sincere.
Sincere devotion to the good. Fortunate.
Bound firmly in loyalty; honored at the sacred mountain.

hexagrams.summary: Repairing what has been spoiled. Think carefully before and after you begin.
hexagrams.image: Wind at the foot of the mountain; rouse people and strengthen their spirit.
line_texts: Fixing what the father damaged. Risky, but it ends well.
Fixing what the mother damaged. Don't be too harsh.
Fixing the father's damage brings slight regret, no great fault.
Putting up with the father's damage leads to embarrassment.
Fixing the father's damage earns praise.
Not serving kings or lords; holding a higher aim.

hexagrams.summary: Strength draws near and things grow. Use it well before the season turns.
hexagrams.image: Earth above the lake; teach without tiring and protect without limit.
line_texts: Approaching together. Steadiness is fortunate.
Approaching together. Fortunate; everything works.
An easy, complacent approach. Nothing works until you take it to heart.
A thorough approach. No fault.
A wise approach, fit for a great leader. Fortunate.
A big-hearted approach. Fortunate, no fault.

hexagrams.summary: Observing and being observed. Sincere example inspires respect.
hexagrams.image: Wind passing over the earth; tour the land and observe the people.
line_texts: A child's way of looking. Fine for small minds, shameful for leaders.
Peeking through a crack in the door. A narrow view.
Reflecting on your own life decides whether to advance or retreat.
Observing the brightness of the realm. Be a guest of the ruler.
Examining my own life. The noble person is blameless.
Examining one's life from outside it. No fault.

hexagrams.summary: An obstacle must be bitten through. Firm, fair justice clears the way.
hexagrams.image: Thunder and lightning; make penalties clear and enforce the law.
line_texts: Feet locked in the stocks. A small lesson; no fault.
Biting into soft meat, nose disappears. No fault.
Biting old dried meat and hitting something bad. Minor embarrassment.
Biting gristle and finding metal arrowheads. Hard work pays off.
Biting dried meat and finding gold. Stay alert to danger.
Locked in a heavy collar, ears hidden. Misfortune.

hexagrams.summary: Beauty and form. Adornment serves small matters, not the essentials.
hexagrams.image: Fire at the foot of the mountain; clarify everyday matters, but don't settle big disputes on looks.
line_texts: Decorate your toes; leave the carriage and walk.
Grooming the beard. Form follows substance.
Polished and glossy. Lasting steadiness is fortunate.
Grace or simplicity? A white horse arrives like wings; a suitor, not a raider.
Grace in the hills and gardens; a modest gift. Awkward at first, fortunate in the end.
Plain white simplicity. No fault.

hexagrams.summary: Erosion from below. Don't start anything; hold still and wait it out.
hexagrams.image: The mountain rests on the earth; secure your place by generosity to those below.
line_texts: The bed's legs are split. Loyalty undermined. Misfortune.
The bed is split at the frame. Misfortune.
Breaking with them. No fault.
The split reaches the skin. Misfortune.
A line of fish; favor comes through those close to power.
One large fruit left uneaten. The noble gains support; the petty lose their roof.

hexagrams.summary: The turning point. Light returns after darkness and movement resumes naturally.
hexagrams.image: Thunder deep in the earth; rest at the turning of the year.
line_texts: Turning back after a short way. No regret. Very fortunate.
A quiet, willing return. Fortunate.
Returning again and again. Risky, but no fault.
Walking with the crowd, returning alone.
Returning with an honest heart. No regret.
Missing the moment to return. Misfortune for a long time.

hexagrams.summary: Act without hidden motives. Spontaneity in tune with heaven succeeds; scheming fails.
hexagrams.image: Thunder rolls beneath the sky; nourish all things in step with the season.
line_texts: Acting without guile. Fortunate.
Plowing without counting on the harvest. Then it pays to act.
Bad luck you didn't earn: a tethered cow taken by a passerby.
You can stay the course. No fault.
Don't treat a sickness you didn't cause; it passes on its own.
Acting now, even innocently, goes wrong. Nothing works.

hexagrams.summary: Great strength held in check and stored up. Stay put and feed your character.
hexagrams.image: Heaven inside the mountain; study the words and deeds of the past.
line_texts: Danger ahead. Stop.
The axle pins are pulled from the wagon. You can't move yet.
A fine horse following others. Train daily and prepare defenses.
A guard board on a young bull's horns. Very fortunate.
A boar's tusk tamed early. Fortunate.
Reaching heaven's open road. Success.

hexagrams.summary: Notice what nourishes you and what you choose to feed on.
hexagrams.image: Thunder under the mountain; be careful with words and moderate in eating.
line_texts: You let your own treasure go and stare at mine. Misfortune.
Seeking food from the heights, off the proper path. Misfortune.
Turning away from real nourishment. Don't act for a long time.
Looking upward for nourishment with a hungry tiger's focus. No fault.
Leaving the usual path. Stay steady; don't cross the great water.
The source of nourishment. Aware of danger, fortunate.

hexagrams.summary: The roof beam sags under too much weight. Act decisively but gently to relieve the strain.
hexagrams.image: The lake rises over the trees; stand alone without fear and withdraw without gloom.
line_texts: Lay soft white rushes underneath. Care is no fault.
A dry poplar sends out new shoots; an old man takes a young wife. Things work.
The beam sags to breaking. Misfortune.
The beam is braced. Fortunate, but hidden motives bring embarrassment.
A dry poplar blooms; an old woman takes a young husband. No blame, no praise.
Wading in over your head. Misfortune, but no fault.

hexagrams.summary: Danger repeated. Keep your heart sincere and move like water, filling each hollow.
hexagrams.image: Water flows on without stopping; keep virtue steady and keep teaching.
line_texts: Deeper into the pit. Misfortune.
The chasm is dangerous. Aim only for small gains.
Pit after pit, forward and back. Stop and wait.
A jug of wine, a bowl of rice, simple vessels passed through a window. Plain sincerity; no fault.
The pit is not overflowing, only filled to the edge. No fault.
Bound with ropes among thorns for years. Misfortune.

hexagrams.summary: Clarity depends on what it holds to. Gentle, caring dependence brings fortune.
hexagrams.image: Light doubled; let brightness reach every direction.
line_texts: Footsteps crossing every way. Stay serious and you're blameless.
Golden yellow light. Very fortunate.
Light of the setting sun. Sing or grieve over aging. Misfortune.
It flares up suddenly, burns out and is discarded.
Floods of tears and sighs. Fortunate.
The ruler sends him out. Strike the leaders, spare the followers. No fault.

hexagrams.summary: Mutual attraction. An open, receptive mind draws others in.
hexagrams.image: A lake on top of the mountain; receive people with an empty mind.
line_texts: Influence felt in the big toe. Just a stirring.
Influence in the calves. Staying put is fortunate.
Influence in the thighs, clinging to whoever leads. Going on is embarrassing.
Steadiness is fortunate. Anxious coming and going reaches only your circle.
Influence at the back of the neck. No regret.
Influence in the jaw, cheeks and tongue. Just talk.

hexagrams.summary: Endurance through constancy, like a long partnership that keeps renewing itself.
hexagrams.image: Thunder and wind; stand firm and keep your direction.
line_texts: Seeking permanence too fast. Misfortune.
Regret fades.
Inconsistent character invites disgrace.
No game in the field. Wrong place.
Constant in character. Right for some roles, wrong for others.
Restlessness as a habit. Misfortune.

hexagrams.summary: Strategic withdrawal as lesser forces rise. Retreat is not surrender.
hexagrams.image: A mountain under the sky; keep petty people at a distance, reserved but not hostile.
line_texts: At the tail of the retreat. Dangerous; don't start anything.
Held fast with yellow oxhide; nothing can pull it loose.
A retreat that gets held up. Stressful; keep good helpers close.
Retreating by choice. Fortunate for the noble, ruin for the petty.
A friendly, well-timed retreat. Steadiness is fortunate.
A cheerful retreat. Everything works.

hexagrams.summary: Strength in motion. Great power has to be guided by what is right.
hexagrams.image: Thunder high in the sky; don't step outside proper order.
line_texts: Power in the toes. Pushing forward goes wrong.
Steadiness is fortunate.
The petty use force, the noble don't. A ram butts a fence and gets its horns stuck.
The fence gives way. Strength like the axle of a big cart.
Losing the ram easily. No regret.
A ram stuck in the fence, can't go forward or back. Admit the difficulty and it turns out well.

hexagrams.summary: Quick, easy advance, like the sun rising. Recognition from above.
hexagrams.image: The sun rises over the earth; let your own good qualities shine.
line_texts: Advancing, then pushed back. Stay steady and calm even if not trusted.
Advancing amid worry. Blessing arrives from an elder.
Everyone agrees. Regret fades.
Advancing like a hoarding rodent. Persisting is dangerous.
Regret fades. Don't fret over gains and losses.
Advancing with the horns, only to discipline your own people.

hexagrams.summary: Brightness wounded. Hide your light and hold steady through hardship.
hexagrams.image: The light sinks into the earth; dim your light outwardly while it shines within.
line_texts: Wings drooping in flight. Keep moving even without food.
Wounded in the left thigh, saved by a strong horse. Fortunate.
Hunting in the south, the dark leader is caught. Don't expect quick change.
Seeing into the heart of the darkness, leave by the gate.
Hiding one's light, like a loyal prince under a tyrant. Steadiness works.
No light, only darkness. First climbing to heaven, then falling into the earth.

hexagrams.summary: Order within the household. When each member plays their part, the whole thrives.
hexagrams.image: Wind rising from fire; let words have substance and conduct have constancy.
line_texts: Clear boundaries inside the home. Regret fades.
Tending the food and the hearth. Steadiness is fortunate.
When tempers rise, firmness beats indulgence. Silly laughter ends in shame.
She is the wealth of the house. Very fortunate.
A ruler cares for his household. No fear; fortunate.
His work earns respect. Fortunate in the end.

hexagrams.summary: Estrangement and polarity. Small matters can still go well.
hexagrams.image: Fire above, lake below; stay yourself while living among others.
line_texts: Lost horses come back on their own. Meet difficult people; no fault.
Running into the lord in a narrow lane. No fault.
The wagon dragged back, the oxen stopped. A bad start, a good end.
Isolated, then meeting a kindred spirit. Risky, no fault.
Your ally bites through the barrier. Going to them is no fault.
Alone, you see monsters where there is a friend coming to court, not to rob.

hexagrams.summary: An obstacle ahead. Pause, look inward, and ask capable people for help.
hexagrams.image: Water on the mountain; turn your attention to yourself and shape your character.
line_texts: Going forward meets obstacles; coming back earns praise.
A servant meets obstacle after obstacle, through no fault of his own.
Going forward meets obstacles, so he turns back.
Going forward meets obstacles; coming back brings allies.
In the middle of great obstacles, friends arrive.
Going forward meets obstacles; coming back brings great fortune.

hexagrams.summary: Tension released. Return to normal fast and finish what's left without delay.
hexagrams.image: Thunder and rain clear the air; forgive mistakes and pardon wrongs.
line_texts: No fault.
Catching three foxes in the field, receiving a yellow arrow. Steadiness works.
Riding in a carriage while hauling a load invites thieves.
Shake off what clings to you; then a true friend arrives.
Only the noble can free themselves; it shows the petty they mean it.
Shooting the hawk from the high wall. It hits; everything works.

hexagrams.summary: Trimming what's excessive, sincerely. Even a small offering is enough.
hexagrams.image: A lake at the foot of the mountain; control anger and restrain impulses.
line_texts: Leave quickly once the work is done. Consider how much to take from others.
Steadiness works. Help others without diminishing yourself.
Three traveling lose one; one traveling finds a companion.
Reduce your faults and others hurry over gladly.
Help comes that can't be turned away. Very fortunate.
Gain without taking from others. Helpers come, though you have no home.

hexagrams.summary: Gain flows downward. A time to act boldly and help others.
hexagrams.image: Wind and thunder; copy the good you see and drop the faults you find.
line_texts: Time to do great things. Very fortunate.
Help comes that can't be turned away. Lasting steadiness is fortunate.
Gaining through hard events. Sincerity keeps you blameless.
Walking the middle way and advising the leader, who listens.
A kind heart doesn't need to ask. Very fortunate.
Helping no one; someone strikes. Misfortune.

hexagrams.summary: Resolute action against wrongdoing. Bring it into the open, without force of arms.
hexagrams.image: The lake has risen to heaven; share generously and don't coast on past virtue.
line_texts: Strength in the toes, but going without winning is a mistake.
A cry of alarm, weapons in the night. Don't fear.
Grim-faced, walking alone in the rain, misunderstood. No fault.
Skin rubbed off the thighs, walking is hard. Let yourself be led and regret fades.
Pulling weeds firmly by the roots. Walking the middle keeps you blameless.
No warning cry. Misfortune comes in the end.

hexagrams.summary: An unexpected encounter with an influence that grows fast. Don't give it a foothold.
hexagrams.image: Wind under heaven; the ruler sends orders to every quarter.
line_texts: Hold it with a bronze brake. Letting it run brings misfortune.
A fish in the tank. No fault, but don't serve it to guests.
Skin rubbed off the thighs, walking is hard. Risky, no great mistake.
No fish in the tank. Misfortune starts here.
A melon shaded by willow leaves. Hidden excellence, a gift from above.
Meeting with lowered horns. Embarrassing, but no fault.

hexagrams.summary: People assemble around a leader and shared values. Generous offerings bring fortune.
hexagrams.image: The lake rises above the earth; renew your defenses against the unexpected.
line_texts: Sincerity that wavers brings confusion. One handshake, then laughter; no fault.
Letting yourself be drawn in is fortunate. Sincerity makes a small offering enough.
Gathering with sighs. Going on is no fault, a little awkward.
Very fortunate. No fault.
Gathering because of rank. If some doubt, stay steady and regret fades.
Sighs and tears. No fault.

hexagrams.summary: Steady rise through effort, like a tree growing. Seek out people of stature.
hexagrams.image: Wood growing inside the earth; pile up small things to reach great ones.
line_texts: Rising with welcome. Very fortunate.
Sincerity makes a small offering enough. No fault.
Rising into an empty city. No resistance.
Honored at the sacred mountain. Fortunate, no fault.
Steadiness is fortunate. Climb step by step.
Rising blindly in the dark. Only relentless steadiness helps.

hexagrams.summary: Exhaustion and confinement. Words won't persuade; stay cheerful and keep your inner faith.
hexagrams.image: A lake with no water; stake your life on your purpose.
line_texts: Sitting under a bare tree, lost in a dark valley for years.
Weighed down even while eating and drinking. Help in red sashes arrives.
Pressed by stone, leaning on thorns, coming home to an empty house.
Arriving slowly, hemmed in by a golden carriage. Awkward, but it ends.
Cut off above and below. Relief comes slowly; keep up your offerings.
Tangled in creeping vines. You fear moving; move anyway and it goes well.

hexagrams.summary: The source that doesn't change. Keep the rope long and the bucket whole.
hexagrams.image: Water raised over wood; encourage people in their work and in helping each other.
line_texts: Nobody drinks muddy well water; animals skip an old well.
Shooting fish in the well-hole; the jar is cracked and leaks.
The well is clean but unused, and that saddens me. It could be drawn from.
The well is being relined. No fault.
The well holds a clear, cold spring. Drink.
Water drawn freely, the well uncovered and reliable. Very fortunate.

hexagrams.summary: Molting and renewal. Change is trusted only when its time has truly come.
hexagrams.image: Fire inside the lake; set the calendar straight and make the seasons clear.
line_texts: Wrapped tight in yellow oxhide. Not yet.
When the day comes, make the change. Starting is fortunate.
Rushing in goes wrong. When the call for change has come around three times, commit.
Regret fades; people trust you. Changing the order is fortunate.
The leader changes like a tiger. Trusted even before consulting the oracle.
The noble changes like a panther; the petty change only their faces.

hexagrams.summary: Nourishing what is worthy. Culture and refinement offered to a higher purpose.
hexagrams.image: Fire over wood; take your right place and firm up your purpose.
line_texts: A cauldron tipped over clears out what's stale. No fault.
Food in the cauldron. Rivals envy but can't harm me.
The handles are altered; the fine food goes uneaten. Rain will come.
The legs break and the meal spills. Misfortune.
Yellow handles and golden rings. Steadiness works.
Rings of jade. Very fortunate.

hexagrams.summary: A shock like thunder. Fear turns to laughter for those who keep their composure.
hexagrams.image: Thunder after thunder; in awe, put your life in order.
line_texts: The shock hits, then laughter. Fortunate.
The shock brings danger and loss. Don't chase it; it comes back in seven days.
The shock leaves you dazed. If it spurs action, no harm.
The shock gets bogged down in mud.
Shock comes and goes. Nothing is lost, but there is work to do.
Shock brings ruin and wild staring. Pushing ahead goes wrong.

hexagrams.summary: Stillness like a mountain. Rest when it's time to rest, act when it's time to act.
hexagrams.image: Mountains side by side; keep your thoughts within your own situation.
line_texts: Stilling the toes. No fault; lasting steadiness works.
Stilling the calves, unable to save the one you follow. The heart is uneasy.
Stilling the hips, stiffening the spine. Dangerous; the heart burns.
Stilling the torso. No fault.
Stilling the jaw; words come in order. Regret fades.
Generous, settled stillness. Fortunate.

hexagrams.summary: Gradual progress, like a tree on a mountain or a proper courtship. Keep going.
hexagrams.image: A tree on the mountain; live with dignity and improve customs.
line_texts: The wild goose nears the shore. The young one is at risk; talk, no fault.
The goose reaches the rocks. Eating and drinking in peace. Fortunate.
The goose reaches the high plateau. Someone leaves and doesn't return.
The goose reaches a tree and may find a flat branch. No fault.
The goose reaches the summit. A long wait, but nothing stops it in the end.
The goose reaches the cloud heights; its feathers serve the ceremony.

hexagrams.summary: Entering a lesser position on impulse. Pushing ahead goes wrong; know your role.
hexagrams.image: Thunder over the lake; see the passing in light of the lasting.
line_texts: Entering as a junior partner. Limping but walking; going on is fortunate.
One eye that still sees. Quiet steadiness works.
Expecting too much and ending up in a lower role.
Waiting past the usual time. The right match comes later.
A royal bride dressed more plainly than her attendant. Modesty is fortunate.
A basket with no fruit, a ritual with no substance. Nothing works.

hexagrams.summary: Fullness at its peak. Be like the noon sun and don't mourn its passing.
hexagrams.image: Thunder and lightning together; judge cases and carry out penalties.
line_texts: Meeting your counterpart. Ten days together is no fault.
So much shade that stars show at noon. Sincerity is fortunate.
Thick shade, small stars at noon; you break your right arm. No fault.
Stars at noon, then meeting a kindred leader. Fortunate.
Bright talent arrives; blessing and praise. Fortunate.
A grand house that shuts everyone out. Years of isolation. Misfortune.

hexagrams.summary: The traveler far from home. Be careful, modest and correct; small things succeed.
hexagrams.image: Fire on the mountain; be clear and careful with penalties and quick with disputes.
line_texts: Fussing over trivia on the road draws trouble.
Reaching an inn with your belongings and gaining a loyal helper.
The inn burns; the helper is lost. Danger.
A shelter, some means and a tool, but the heart isn't glad.
Downing the pheasant with one arrow; it earns praise and a post.
The bird's nest burns. The wanderer laughs, then weeps.

hexagrams.summary: Penetration through gentleness, like wind. Small, steady influence wins.
hexagrams.image: Wind following wind; spread instructions and carry out the work.
line_texts: Wavering back and forth. A soldier's resolve is what's needed.
Searching under the bed, calling in many advisers. Fortunate.
Searching over and over. Embarrassing.
Regret fades; the hunt brings in three kinds of game.
Steadiness is fortunate. A bad start but a good finish; plan before and after the change.
Searching under the bed, losing your means and your tool. Persisting goes wrong.

hexagrams.summary: Joy shared through openness. Firm inside, gentle outside.
hexagrams.image: Two lakes joined; meet with friends to talk and practice together.
line_texts: Contented, harmonious joy. Fortunate.
Sincere joy. Fortunate; regret fades.
Joy that comes chasing you. Misfortune.
Weighing which joy to choose, uneasy. Drop the faulty one and be glad.
Trusting what is breaking down is dangerous.
Joy that lures you away.

hexagrams.summary: Dissolving what is rigid or divided. Gather people around something sacred.
hexagrams.image: Wind over water; the old kings built temples and honored the divine.
line_texts: Help arrives with a strong horse. Fortunate.
In the breakup, hurry to what supports you. Regret fades.
Dissolving your own self-interest. No regret.
Dissolving your faction. Very fortunate; a great gathering forms.
A great call that loosens like sweat. The leader stays blameless.
Dispersing the danger, going far away. No fault.

hexagrams.summary: Limits give structure, but limits that chafe shouldn't be kept up.
hexagrams.image: Water held in the lake; set measures and examine what virtue is.
line_texts: Not stepping past your own door and courtyard. No fault.
Not going out the gate when you should. Misfortune.
No limits, then lamenting. No one else to blame.
Contented limits. Success.
Sweet, willing limits. Fortunate; going on earns respect.
Bitter, harsh limits. Persisting goes wrong; regret fades if you ease off.

hexagrams.summary: Sincerity that reaches even the least responsive. Inner openness makes influence possible.
hexagrams.image: Wind over the lake; weigh judgments carefully and delay harsh sentences.
line_texts: Being prepared is fortunate. Hidden plans bring unease.
A crane calls from the shade and its young answer. I'll share my good cup with you.
Finding a partner: now drumming, now stopping, now weeping, now singing.
The moon nearly full; a horse leaves its team. No fault.
Truth that binds people together. No fault.
A rooster's cry aimed at heaven. Persisting goes wrong.

hexagrams.summary: Small things can be done, great things can't. Like a bird, stay low.
hexagrams.image: Thunder on the mountain; lean toward reverence, grief and thrift.
line_texts: A bird that flies too high meets misfortune.
Passing the elder to meet the elder's partner. Falling short of the top, meeting the official. No fault.
Without great care, someone strikes from behind. Misfortune.
No fault. Meeting without overstepping. Going on is risky; stay alert.
Thick clouds, no rain yet. The leader hits the target hidden in a cave.
Overshooting, missing the meeting; the bird flies off. Misfortune.

hexagrams.summary: Everything in its place. Order at the start, disorder at the end; stay alert.
hexagrams.image: Water over fire; anticipate trouble and prepare against it.
line_texts: Braking the wheels; the fox wets its tail. No fault.
The carriage curtain is lost. Don't chase it; it returns in seven days.
A long campaign won after three years. Don't employ petty people.
Fine clothes turning to rags. Be careful all day.
A modest, sincere offering outweighs a lavish one.
Head under water. Danger.

hexagrams.summary: The transition isn't finished. Like a young fox crossing a river, go carefully.
hexagrams.image: Fire above water; sort things carefully so each finds its place.
line_texts: The fox gets its tail wet. Embarrassing.
Braking the wheels. Steadiness is fortunate.
Not yet complete; attacking goes wrong, but crossing the great water works.
Steadiness is fortunate; regret fades. Long effort brings reward.
Steadiness is fortunate, no regret. The noble person's light is genuine.
Drinking wine in good faith. No fault, but drink to the point of soaking your head and you lose it.
